Lexicon.label: Offenes Deutsches WordNet
Lexicon.citation: Melanie Siegel and Francis Bond (2021), OdeNet: Compiling a German Wordnet from other Resources, *11th International Global Wordnet Conference (GWC2021)*
Lexicon.dc:description: OdeNet is an open Wordnet for the German language. It is based on openThesaurus, a crowd-developed thesaurus of German, and automatically linked to the Princeton WordNet with some hand checking. It was started in May 2017.
